name: Hagenow (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, with the bust of a bishop from the city arms of Hagenow in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was designed by the Barsbüttel heraldist Hans-Frieder Kühne and approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 15 March 1996; the red stripe carries the figure of the city arms in the upper hoist.

features.role: bust of a mitred bishop from the city arms
